Taxes on failures by hospital organizations If a hospital organization to which section 501(r) applies fails to meet the requirement of section 501(r)(3) for any taxable year, there is imposed on the organization a tax equal to $50,000. (Added Pub. L. 111–148, title IX, §9007(b)(1), Mar. 23, 2010, 124 Stat. 857 .)
